title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
creator: Stanley Kubrick
summary: Humanity's leap from tool-using apes to a voyage beyond Jupiter, where the computer HAL turns killer and Bowman passes through the Star Gate to be reborn.

title: Hamlet
creator: William Shakespeare
summary: Prince Hamlet, commanded by his father's ghost to avenge his murder by Claudius, delays in doubt and grief until a poisoned duel destroys the whole court.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
creator: J. K. Rowling
summary: Orphan Harry learns he is a wizard, finds friends at Hogwarts, learns magic, and with Ron and Hermione stops Voldemort from seizing the Philosopher's Stone.

title: In Search of Lost Time
creator: Marcel Proust
summary: A narrator recovers his life through involuntary memory: childhood at Combray, loves and jealousies over Gilberte and Albertine, salon snobbery, and his calling as a writer.

title: Journey to the West
creator: Wu Cheng'en
summary: Monkey, Pigsy, and Sandy guard the monk Tripitaka on a comic, demon-haunted pilgrimage to India for Buddhist scriptures, fighting monsters that want to eat him.

title: Little Red Riding Hood
summary: A girl carrying food to her sick grandmother is tricked by a wolf that eats the grandmother and then her; in the Grimm version a hunter frees them.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
creator: Agatha Christie
summary: Snowbound on the Orient Express, Hercule Poirot deduces that twelve passengers together stabbed the child-killer Cassetti to avenge the Armstrong family.

title: One Piece
creator: Eiichiro Oda
summary: Luffy and his Straw Hat crew sail the Grand Line for the One Piece treasure, exploring islands, fighting pirates and Marines, and defending their friends.

title: The Iliad
creator: Homer
summary: Achilles's wrath over a slight to his honor, the Greeks' suffering without him, his vengeance for Patroclus, and the grief and pity that end the poem.

title: The Metamorphosis
creator: Franz Kafka
summary: Gregor Samsa wakes as a giant insect; his family's care curdles into disgust and shame, he stops eating, and he dies unmourned.

title: The Shining
creator: Stanley Kubrick
summary: Isolated as winter caretaker of the haunted Overlook Hotel, Jack Torrance goes mad and hunts his wife and psychic son with an axe through the snow.

title: The Song of Roland
summary: Betrayed by his stepfather Ganelon, Roland dies with the rear guard at Roncevaux rather than call for help, and Charlemagne avenges him on the Saracens and the traitor.

title: The Tale of Genji
creator: Murasaki Shikibu
summary: Prince Genji's lifelong pursuit of love affairs at the Heian court, the jealousies and shames they cause, and the sorrow of impermanence that shadows every bond.

title: Titanic
creator: James Cameron
summary: Aboard the doomed Titanic, upper-class Rose falls in love with penniless Jack; the ship sinks into freezing water and he dies saving her.
